detail.longDescription:
It's a huge horse, but I'll ride it or die unhappy if I don't win this bloody war! 

I wish I could do it on a large scale (10k+), but even 100 slowly dying ppl & staying free is epic.

😈 AI + vulnerable ppl = suicide!

If I fail? I simply quit too!
I'm always ready to die – death's my best friend.
